text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool here, so I found the bugs by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the `Emma` book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or negative.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.

I didn't modify any tests.
